document.title: System pro M compact — DIN Rail components for low voltage installation

modelingNotes: S1: ABB 2014 catalog, printed 2/38, explicitly maps 2CDS271001R0104 to S 201 M-C 10: one pole, C characteristic, rated current 10 A.

S1 printed 11/2 shows the S201 single-pole circuit with manufacturer terminal numbers 1 and 2 and an open breaker contact. Applied to the S201M variant using the same catalog S200/S200M construction and exact one-pole selection. normal_state=open records the depicted OFF state, not automatic spring return or an asserted installed state.

S1 printed 2/14-2/15 and 2/20 describe top and bottom twin terminals, each with conductor and busbar entry parts. Each numbered electrical terminal is represented once with shared connection policy; insertion openings are not additional numbered poles. Supply side is selectable. No phase or mandatory line/load direction is assigned.

S1 printed 2/16: IEC/EN 60898-1 one-pole Un 230/400 V AC, Icn 10 kA, frequency 50/60 Hz, C-curve reference temperature 30 degrees C. IEC/EN 60947-2 one-pole Ue 230 V AC, Icu 15 kA, Ics 11.2 kA for In <=40 A; C reference temperature 55 degrees C. Voltage and interrupting limits remain conditional documentation, not scalar supply intent. Terminal current field is rated In, not trip threshold or wire ampacity.

S1 printed 2/20: top/bottom conductor cross-sections 35 mm2 solid/stranded or 25 mm2 flexible; busbar 10 mm2; tightening torque 2.8 Nm. Insertion capacity and tightening are not automatically enforced by shared connection policy.

Bare breaker only. Auxiliary and signal contacts, releases and motor operators are separately fitted accessories, not connections supplied by this order code. No neutral, PE/bond, shield or communications connection is shown for the one-pole insulated breaker.

No fixed link connects terminals 1 and 2: the breaker opens manually or on trip. The contact function and circuit symbol do not merge nets. Neither terminal is universally required in every authored instance; application wiring determines usage.

connectionCoverage.notes: Bare ordered breaker: two numbered electrical terminals, 1 and 2, each a twin terminal with conductor and busbar insertion parts (four insertion parts total). Both parts of each terminal use its one shared electrical key. One interruptible pole; no neutral, PE/bond, shield, signal, communication or fitted auxiliary-contact terminals. Accessories are outside this identity.
